items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.
items.claim: At Exodus 9:8, instructions specify a physical mechanism: taking handfuls of furnace ashes and sprinkling them toward heaven before Pharaoh
items.place: toward heaven, in sight of Pharaoh
items.mechanism: taking handfuls of ashes and sprinkling toward heaven
